A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 47-page versions of Private Zeroth-Order Optimization with Public Data. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, Appendices A-C, and checklist support reliable comparison.

before.justification: V1 reports original training and evaluation results on four vision and language datasets, including accuracy, runtime, distribution-shift, and hyperparameter experiments in Section 5 and Appendix C.

after.justification: V2 retains these original empirical results, including the accuracy comparisons in Tables 2-5 and runtime measurements in Table 8.

M1.justification: Algorithms 1-3 retain the same PAZO-M gradient mixing, PAZO-P public-gradient subspace sampling, and PAZO-S candidate selection procedures. No method component or update rule changes.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate CIFAR-10, Tiny-ImageNet, IMDB, and MNLI with the same training tasks, public-data sources, and distribution-shift scenarios described in Appendix C.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain DP-SGD, DPZero, DPMD, DOPE-SGD, and GEP. The non-private SGD/MeZO references and public-only comparisons are also unchanged.

E3.justification: The data preparation, privacy budgets, metrics, model configurations, training budgets, and tuning procedures remain unchanged. Table 13 corrects a separator in the MNLI DOPE-SGD batch-size list, without changing its values or establishing a revised protocol.

E4.justification: Both retain the public-only comparison, public/private distribution-shift analysis, orthonormalization comparison, and sensitivity studies for query counts and introduced hyperparameters. Figures 6 and 8 and Tables 6, 7, and 11 contain the same analyses.

E5.justification: Appendix C.2 still specifies random seed 0, and Table 8 still averages runtime over 20 iterations. The checklist retains the same disclosure that experimental error bars are not reported; no uncertainty estimation or significance testing is added.

E6.justification: The numerical results, plotted findings, and rankings are unchanged. For example, Table 2 reports PAZO-M accuracy of 71.3% on CIFAR-10 at epsilon = 1 in both versions, and Table 8 retains its runtime of 0.051 seconds per iteration.

T1.justification: V2 adds a Section 4 summary of the bounded-loss assumption and sharper PAZO-M/PAZO-P bounds, but these already appear in v1's Table 1 and Appendices B.5-B.6. The assumptions, theorems, derivations, and proofs themselves are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about PAZO, convergence guarantees, privacy/utility advantages, and runtime speedups of up to 16 times. The added theory summary does not expand those contributions.

C2.justification: The added bounded-loss discussion summarizes the clipping/noise rationale already documented in Appendix B. Interpretations of empirical results, applicability qualifications, and the future-work discussion otherwise remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hardware, hyperparameter values, data-processing descriptions, and code-access statements are retained. Table 13 changes '{8. 32}' to '{8, 32}' for DOPE-SGD on MNLI, a punctuation correction rather than new reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Both versions contain the same 49 references and the same substantive comparisons with prior research. Bibliography entries shift between pages without additions, removals, or revised positioning.

P1.justification: Section 4 gains a short summary of existing bounded-loss results and more precise references to Appendices B.2-B.6 and Table 1. Other edits are limited to notation wording, the Table 13 punctuation correction, and the version/date stamp.

P2.justification: The added paragraph causes local reflow: Figures 2-3 now follow the Section 5.2 heading, and later text and Figure 6 shift position. Figure content, captions, and table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: V2 makes the existing bounded-loss guarantees easier to discover through its Section 4 summary and precise appendix references, and fixes a small table typo. These provide a modest clarity and navigation improvement; the underlying methods, proofs, and empirical support remain unchanged.
